cohort: Women who conceived through ART and a control group of women who conceived spontaneously
finding: ART was associated with an increased rate of placental abnormalities, including abnormal umbilical cord insertion and increased rates of adherent placentation.
mod_finding: ART pregnancies had higher rates of adherent placentas at delivery (3% vs. 0%, p=0.014) compared to spontaneously conceived pregnancies.
birth_weight: Lower in the ART group (2,928±803 g vs. 3,273±586 g; p<0.001)
